name: Base Prompt Variants (diction + vocal-forward)
description: Compares base-prompt variants A/B/C on diction and vocal-forward mix

criteria.label: Diction / articulation (مخارج الحروف)
criteria.help: Are consonants and word endings crisp and correctly pronounced?

criteria.label: Vocal-forward mix (not masked)
criteria.help: Can you hear every word over guitars/strings/drums?

criteria.label: Overall vocal intelligibility
criteria.help: Gut call: how easily could you transcribe the words by ear? (drives the ranking)

criteria.label: Overall quality
criteria.help: Whole-take quality, so a variant can't win by wrecking the music.

criteria.label: Notes
criteria.help: e.g. which words were unclear, reverb smear, vocal ducking
